newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Pirelli confirms bid for P. Tyre. [CORRECTED 12:32 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Pirelli confirms bid for P. Tyre. [CORRECTED 12:32 GMT]

text.p: Pirelli SpA confirmed on Monday that it would make a public offer of 19.50 guilders per share for all outstanding shares of Pirelli Tyre Holding NV.
Milan-listed Pirelli SpA currently holds 93.6 percent of the shares in Amsterdam-listed Pirelli Tyre Holding.

In a joint statement Pirelli SpA and Pirelli Tyre said the offer would be open from January 28 to February 24, with Pirelli SpA expected to announce no later than February 27 whether it will go ahead and implement the offer.
Pirelli Tyre will hold an extraordinary meeting of shareholders on February 13 to inform shareholders about the offer.
Pirelli SpA first publicly announced its plans to buy out minority shareholders in Pirelli Tyre at a price of 19.50 guilders per share on January 14.
